decks.title: Problem Solving
decks.description: Practice real-life choices and social problem solving

prompts.text: You are taking a test and the person behind you asks for help. They want to know what you put for question number two. What could you do?
You waited in line at a birthday party to hit the pinata. It is finally your turn and it looks like the next hit will break it, but you suddenly have to go to the bathroom. What could you do?
You are outside with your friend and they pick your neighbor's flowers. They hand the flowers to you right as your neighbor opens the door and asks why you picked them. What could you do?
You borrowed your sister's skates without asking and they broke while you were using them. What could you do?
You are eating at a friend's house and their mom gives you a lot of food. It looks good, but you cannot eat it all because you just had a snack. What could you do so you do not hurt her feelings?
Your friends come over for movie night. One friend brings another friend, so now you need six drinks, but you only have five cans of soda. What could you do?
After basketball practice, you go back to the locker room to shower and change. When you are done dressing, you cannot find your shoes. What could you do?
You have been waiting all day for lunch because you are starving. When you go to get your lunch, it is not there. You probably left it at home. What could you do?

decks.title: Would You Rather: Big Choices
decks.description: Big dilemmas, values, and surprising choices

prompts.text: Would you rather know the exact date and time you will die, or know the exact cause of your death?
Would you rather live ten years as an isolated genius, or live an average life surrounded by loved ones?
Would you rather always tell the truth but never be believed, or always be believed but only speak lies?
Would you rather have a perfect memory of every mistake, or never remember anyone’s names?
Would you rather get $10,000 a month for doing nothing, or $100,000 a month while working six days a week?
Would you rather be underpaid at your dream job, or wealthy and bored at a job you hate?
Would you rather lose all your memories so far, or never form new long-term memories?
Would you rather sacrifice taste, or sacrifice half your hearing?
Would you rather give up the internet forever, or give up travel outside your country?
Would you rather always be 15 minutes late, or 30 minutes early to everything?
Would you rather tell your biggest secret to your boss, or send your search history to your family?
Would you rather be a famous historical figure remembered for your accomplishments or an anonymous person who makes a significant impact on the world today?
Would you rather be loved by many but never truly know who genuinely cares for you or have a few close, loyal friends but be disliked by others?
Would you rather have the power to bring people together but be unable to form personal connections or form deep, meaningful connections but struggle to unite others?
Would you rather have the ability to time travel to witness historical events or visit the future to see advancements in technology?
Would you rather have the power to heal others or the power to resurrect the dead?
Would you rather experience the highs and lows of intense emotions or live a more emotionally stable but subdued life?
Would you rather have the power to heal physical wounds or mend emotional scars?
Would you rather be known for your intelligence or your kindness?
Would you rather always speak the truth but hurt people's feelings or tell comforting lies to spare them pain?
Would you rather live in a world with absolute justice but no personal freedom or a world with personal freedom but imperfect justice?
Would you rather be able to relive your happiest memories or erase your most painful ones?
Would you rather have the power to erase all hatred from the world or eliminate all poverty?
Would you rather be a world-renowned artist with no personal connections or have a close-knit community but never achieve fame?
Would you rather have the ability to bring people together or heal divisions within society?
Would you rather be respected but not loved or loved but not respected?
Would you rather have the power to end world hunger or bring about world peace?
Would you rather have the courage to pursue your passion but face constant criticism or live a comfortable life without ever chasing your dreams?
Would you rather possess the knowledge of the universe but be unable to share it or have the ability to inspire and teach others without extensive knowledge?
Would you rather be the first person to discover an alien civilization or unravel the mysteries of the deepest parts of the ocean?
Would you rather be able to see the beauty in every moment but experience intense sadness or live a more emotionally neutral life?
Would you rather have the power to bring joy to others but carry the weight of their sorrows or remain emotionally detached?
Would you rather have the ability to experience the perspectives of others or have them understand your own experiences deeply?
Would you rather be remembered for your contributions to society or the positive impact you've had on individual lives?
Would you rather be a genius in a world that doesn't appreciate intelligence or have average intelligence in a world that values and celebrates it?
Would you rather be able to speak to the souls of those who have passed away or have profound conversations with future generations?
Would you rather have the power to forgive and forget or hold onto grudges but never forget the lessons they teach?
Would you rather have the ability to travel through time and witness historical events or be a catalyst for positive change in your present time?
Would you rather have a deep connection with a few people or a shallow connection with many?
Would you rather have the power to bring happiness to others but not experience it yourself or be deeply content but unable to share that feeling?
Would you rather have the courage to face your greatest fears and fail or live a life of comfort without ever confronting your fears?
